newsitem.title: CHINA: PRESS DIGEST - Chinese newspapers - Dec 27.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Chinese newspapers - Dec 27.

text.p: Following is a summary of major Chinese political and business stories in leading newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Beijing. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy. Telephone: (8610) 6532-1921. Fax: (8610) 6532-4978.
Report says commentary issued last week by the People's Daily has to a certain extent controlled excessive speculation in the stock markets.
Law on township enterprises aimed at protecting rural interests to go into effect on January, 1.
China sets 15 billion yuan quota for corporate bonds to finance basic infrastructure.
China collects 610 billion yuan in industrial and commercial taxes, up by 19 percent compared with last year.
More than 300 cases involving losses of state property investigated, saving 2.1 billion yuan.
Senior Beijing city government official expelled from Communist Party for corruption.
China's deficit-ridden coal industry adapting to market economy ahead of schedule.
Eastern Chinese regional leaders pledge to channel funds to less developed western areas.
Guatemala criticised for inviting Taiwan foreign minister to signing ceremony.
